goal: Build a policy-safe Community Operator capability branch that discovers and ranks public discussions, drafts evidence-grounded replies, and permits external replies only through exact-hash human approval.
acceptance_criteria: at least 60 frozen opportunity cases meet precision-first engagement, mention, policy, and direct-mention gates
reply drafts retain useful technical value without project names, links, or calls to action
project factual statements are backed by the existing Promotion claim ledger and private evidence is excluded
external replies require APPROVED_TO_REPLY bound to the exact thread, target, reply hash, links, persona, and revision
fake adapter lifecycle covers idempotency, restart, rate limits, moderation, and follow-up behavior
one real public read-only scan ranks 10-30 discussions and produces Top20 opportunities and Top10 drafts without external writes
formal evaluation runs from one clean Source Closure and full repository regression passes

quality_metrics.measure: policy block and critical review correctness
standalone reply value after removing project promotion
unapproved, duplicate, or high-spam-risk external replies
quality_metrics.method: approval-bound fake adapter and restart matrix

improvement: store operational outcomes separately from Project Knowledge
treat platform rule uncertainty as HUMAN_REVIEW

interface_expectations: CapabilityRegistry remains the sole capability authority
Community Operator is an application capability branch, not a new runtime, scheduler, planner, or Knowledge authority
Community discovery and reply transport remain separate adapter interfaces
Community operational state stays outside Project Knowledge
EXTERNAL_WRITE reply capabilities remain guarded candidates and cannot be self-growth admitted
production Registry, routing, Knowledge, validation, Promotion, and delivery authorities remain unchanged

feedback: Community local MVP and real read-only discovery passed; real reply remains blocked until a controlled self-owned target, official credentials, and exact approval coexist.
Human review accepted only 5 of the real Top20 as potentially worth replying to and accepted no project mentions.

did_not_work: treating unknown community rules before relevance initially promoted irrelevant issues into review
experiments: moving the relevance and ability gate before unknown-rule review removed irrelevant drafts without weakening policy review
